items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses,
Say unto Aaron, Stretch forth thine hand with thy rod over the streams, over the rivers, and over the ponds, and cause frogs to come up upon the land of Egypt.
items.claim: Aaron was commanded to stretch forth his hand with his rod over the waters and cause frogs to come up upon the land of Egypt
items.action: Stretch forth hand with thy rod, cause frogs to come up
items.place: streams, rivers, ponds, land of Egypt
